standing_rules: At chat start read RULES.MD on main and this state, then verify live GitHub refs/issues before acting.
GitHub is source/control plane; OpenVMS V9.2-3 x86-64 is canonical compile/link/RMS/runtime acceptance.
Omit literal OVMS-AGENT> from commands supplied for paste; native DCL $ prompts are acceptable.
Use GITAUTH for authenticated Git network operations and keep core.filemode=false.
Never trust OpenVMS Git porcelain/ref output or $STATUS alone when RMS-visible files/control files can verify.
For OpenVMS working-tree state, use AGENT/GIT/REFRESH and AGENT/GIT/STATUS when direct Git encounters known #149 RMS short-read behavior.
Consult DOC/OPENVMS_GIT_QUIRKS.MD before inventing materialization workflows.
When source/build/runtime inputs change, native acceptance requires All regression tests passed., Build completed successfully., and BUILD_STATUS=%X00000001 plus focused regressions as needed.
Distinguish exact native-tested SHA from tree/source/HLP-equivalent promoted commits; never call an untested GitHub head native-green.
Keep OVMS_AGENT.HLP synchronized with user-visible command/settings/material behavior changes.
Externally visible DEC C/VAX-facing identifiers remain <=31 chars and C89/DEC C compatible unless required otherwise.
Permanently keep main and chat-session-state; retain only the two most recently completed milestone branches unless unique unpromoted work requires retention.
